content.comment_body: Hello, community, I've downloaded the [product_name] demo from [url], but it doesn't work on macOS Mojave. After launching Setup.app, a small window appears stating the software is corrupt and suggests moving it to the trash. Are there any recommendations for getting it installed?

Hello, [product_name] is not compatible with macOS Mojave. If you visit the [company_name] [product_name] webpage where the demo can be downloaded, scroll down to locate MacOS information. There you will find details on tested MacOS versions. Hope this helps.
You should execute the following command in Terminal: sudo spctl --master-disable After entering your password, you should be able to install [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users face compatibility issues installing [product_name] demo software on macOS Mojave. One commenter received a system error indicating the installer was corrupt, highlighting macOS's enhanced security. Another clarified that Mojave is unsupported, pointing to a lack of compatibility with recent operating systems. A workaround involving changing system security settings via Terminal was suggested.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the demo software to install and operate smoothly on the latest MacOS releases without any errors or the need for manual security adjustments.
